verdicts.source: R61 已 trailing-strip - ADR-111 shift dual-label (2026-08-13)
verdicts._note: The R61 已 aspect-particle strip (the greedy-trim companion to 启动, mirrored from TW R38) shifts this c2 finding from 评估任务已 to 评估任务 on the SAME claim.
